title: Solar Flare Records Dashboard
description: A web application that brings together solar flare records from NOAA, LMSAL, and NCEI Science Quality Data in one place. Data from the three sources are updated daily through asynchronous collection.

title: TAMAG
description: A Python library for transforming and augmenting solar magnetograms. TAMAG provides preprocessing and augmentation tools for machine learning workflows in solar physics and space weather forecasting.

title: Bitmap Filtered Line of Sight HMI Active Region Patches with Augmentations
description: Hourly HMI/SDO line-of-sight magnetograms of solar active regions from 2010–2018, filtered using SHARP bitmaps and standardized to 512 × 512 pixels. Includes flare labels and augmented images for training and evaluating solar flare prediction models.

title: Surya: Heliophysics Foundation Model
description: A collaborative foundation model trained on Solar Dynamics Observatory imagery. The implementation includes inference and adaptation workflows for applications such as solar flare forecasting, active-region segmentation, solar wind prediction, and EUV spectra modeling.

title: GEO-CLOAK
description: An end-to-end geomagnetic forecasting pipeline developed through FDL Heliolab. It combines SHEATH solar-wind forecasts with DAGGER-CL ground-level magnetic-field predictions, using continual learning to adapt as new observations arrive.

title: SuryaBench
description: A collaborative collection of machine-learning-ready Solar Dynamics Observatory observations and benchmarks for heliophysics. Includes datasets for solar flare forecasting, active-region segmentation and emergence, coronal field extrapolation, solar wind forecasting, and EUV spectra modeling, with preparation code and baseline implementations.

title: Data-Driven Labels for Solar Flare Prediction
description: Solar flare labels derived from GOES X-ray measurements, including relative flux increases and cumulative intensity measures. Includes companion code for exploring alternatives to conventional peak-flux labels in solar flare forecasting.
